findings.claim: A reservation refusal is the one in-loop failure that halts the run without attempting an operational incident, because `activeReservation` throws before the `try` block that owns every `reportRunnerIncident` call.
findings.reproduction: In tests/promptRefinerShadowRunner.test.mjs make the fixture's `reserve` return `{ ok: false, reason: "stage_capacity_exhausted" }` and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`: the runner rejects with `PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_RESERVATION_REFUSED` while `world.incidents` is `[]`, unlike every other halt path (pre_dispatch, post_dispatch, intent_missing, reservation_release, terminal_write), which all report first. No durable state is left behind and the owner still gets the fixed code in the response, so this is informational only; routing it through `reportRunnerIncident` with `causeCode: result.reason` would make the alert surface complete.
